visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat Zillow / Redfin / Coldwell Banker community pages. Three things no aggregator publishes: an alias-true active count (a resort's homes are MLS-tagged under many subdivision names, so every literal-name count undercounts it), the trace under every figure naming the query that produced it, and the authored knowledge of what belonging to the place costs and involves — HOA, membership, drive times, course, builders, schools, and the second-home reality — beside the live inventory instead of on a separate marketing page.
note: First screen, amended 2026-09-03: the place-page class opener. Order is V3Breadcrumb, place-opening (V3Heading `{Community} homes for sale` + PlaceFaceStrip leftover count/median + full-bleed PlaceAreaHero photo, never Quiet H1 and never an H1 photo cage), V3Atlas (child plats as regions), PlaceTypeSlider, PlaceSplitView (overlayBoundaries from overlaysFromChildCells / getCommunitySubdivisions), Instrument #market, Quiet #belonging (facts and chips as the display, extra prose and the authored story under disclosure), V3CourseMap when mapped, V3PlaceCharacter, Ledger subdivisions, Sheet, Ledger open houses, Ledger activity, V3Answers #faq, Footer. leftoverHudKpis grain stays neighborhood keyed by the bare slug; publishPlaceFace({ grain: 'community', hud }) prints leftover active + leftover median list. Tetherow leftover is the 16 SFR pile, not alias Field length ~25. MOS / sold / verdict / DTP stay off the face. seedRing keys on a TRUSTED polygon: county plat-union first, reliable stored boundary second. Child plat cells draw as Atlas regions AND Split overlayBoundaries, each a door to its page. Type strips, not H2s. Eagle Crest schools are Redmond 2J / getDistrictForCity('Redmond') only. Amenity blogs via getBlogPostsBySlugs. Never plat/nest/parent/child/sibling/CDP/Feeders on visitor copy. THE PUBLIC NAME IS THE REGISTRY LABEL. NO IN-PAGE REDIRECT. buildMarketFaq runs unconditionally with source 'market-truth'.

dataChanges.figureCorrected: The reliable-boundary branch published listings_in_boundary's pin count under the label 'Active single-family'. That RPC filters on status only and caps at 200 rows, so the number counted condos, land, and townhomes, and the median printed beside it came from a DIFFERENT set (the same listings narrowed to propertyType 'A'). The count is now the single-family actives inside the same boundary: the set the label claims and the set its median is computed from. On a community with no condos or land it is the same number.
dataChanges.monthsOfSupplyPublicationRule: REPAIR 2026-08-12. Months of supply, and the verdict clause it puts in the H1, publish ONLY when the market pulse row's own active_count equals the count this page publishes. Months of supply is actives over average monthly closings and this page prints that formula, so the reader can check it against the count beside it. The pulse row computed the ratio from ITS numerator (the literal-subdivision-name count for the slug) while the page publishes the alias-aware one, and on 2026-08-12 they differed on every community carrying a row: tetherow 20 against 36, vandevert-ranch 12 against 0, broken-top 205 against 21. The arithmetic refuted the page in both directions: vandevert-ranch printed 'a buyer's market' and '72.0 months of supply' over '0 homes for sale' (0 actives yields 0 months, and zero inventory is definitionally not a buyer's market), and tetherow printed 'a balanced market' where its own 36 actives against the same denominator give 9.0, a buyer's. The figure now publishes on exactly the communities whose count came FROM that row (three-rivers: 91 actives, 16.1 months, 'a buyer's market', self-consistent) and is cut everywhere else, in the Instrument, in the visible FAQ, and in the Dataset's variableMeasured, from the one buildMarketFaq call. Median days to pending survives the same disagreement: it is a timing median over homes that went pending, prints no formula, and drives no verdict, and its trace names the pulse row.
dataChanges.monthsOfSupplyDisplay: REPAIR 2026-08-12. The figure prints through lib/format/months-of-supply (formatMonthsOfSupply), the single boundary-safe rule: 4.02 prints 4.1, 5.97 prints 5.9. The migration had used Math.round(x*10)/10 with toFixed(1), which is the expression lib/site/market-faq.ts replaced in the same changeset for the reason written in its own comment, and it put three values of one statistic on one page: 4.0 in the Instrument, 4.1 in the visible FAQ answer, 4.1 in the Dataset variable.
dataChanges.unchanged: Every other figure, filter, window, and unit. The alias-aware resort count, the oversized-hull fallback, the county-plat-union polygon rule, the median-list/median-sold split, the rolling-365d window on closed sales, the registry HOA fallback chain, and the school-district registry as the only permitted schools source all behave exactly as before.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + Place + Dataset + FAQPage JSON-LD. All four are emitted here. FAQPage moved into this array because its old emitter left: the KB page emitted it from inside FAQBlock's includeJsonLd, and the v3 Quiet block that renders the questions carries no structured data of its own, so a swap that did not move the payload would have dropped the strongest AI-citation lever silently. 2026-09-08: the FAQPage items are now answersFaqItems(placeAnswers) — derived FROM the rendered rows, not built beside them.

requiredComponents.name: V3SectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Analytics island: section_view + scroll_depth on the one taxonomy (page_type derives from the path). Not a seventh pattern.

requiredComponents.name: CommunityPageTracker
requiredComponents.section: The per-community view event, with the same five props it always took: slug, communityName, city, activeCount, medianPrice. It lives in components/community, outside the five registers ci:public-ui measures, and it is measurement wiring rather than visual language.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Communities > City > Community. Surface tone: the opener is H1 + face + atlas, not an on-media Stage.

requiredComponents.name: V3Heading
requiredComponents.section: Page H1: `${publicName} homes for sale`. Same place-opening as city / neighborhood / subdivision. Not a Quiet headingLevel=1.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, AFTER village bars. Slope or strip of THIS community's closes, never Bend's median. chartFirst + foldAfter={0}. Too-few closes render Quiet. MOS stays off this grain.

requiredComponents.name: PlaceSplitView
requiredComponents.section: First-screen Split. Tetherow seeds the reliable ring (getGeoBoundaryMapData neighborhood + getResortBoundaryGeoJSON). A community with a verified county plat-union (Eagle Crest, Black Butte Ranch, ...) seeds that union even when its stored hull is unreliable; alias tiles still pass as listings override then. overlayBoundaries carries the child plat cells. Face count is leftover, not this list length.

requiredComponents.name: publishPlaceFace
requiredComponents.section: Face publisher. Community grain withholds MOS. Call is publishPlaceFace({ grain: 'community', hud }) — leftover 16 for Tetherow, never alias Field length.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, #belonging. Authored knowledge from _v3/place-knowledge.ts: facts and chips as the display (HOA, drive times, course specs, membership), extra prose and the authored story under disclosure. FAQ is V3Answers, not this Quiet. Market absence is a Quiet only when leftover HUD publishes nothing.

requiredComponents.name: CommunityAlertsStrip
requiredComponents.section: The listing-alert capture, once, as the FIRST CALLOUT after the opening (after CommunityPlaceValue) and BEFORE #atlas (site queue SITE-04, Matt 2026-09-07), plus the sticky repeat past #atlas, both from the barrel's V3AlertsStrip. app/communities/[slug]/_v3/CommunityAlertSheet.client.tsx keeps its file name (ci:publish-median-caption pins the path) and exports CommunityAlertsStrip, which binds V3AlertsStrip to submitSearchAlertSignup with the same payload ({ email, filters, company }, filters carrying city always and subdivision only when the community has one), the same field name `email`, the same trap name `company` forwarding its own value, and the same two post-success effects in the same order: the guest-watch residual, then the alert_create event built by buildAlertCreatePayload('daily'), now carrying `placement`. GHOST BUTTON: the opening's CommunityPlaceValue is the page's one filled primary (one primary per viewport). THE CLAIM IS A REAL FIGURE: Market Truth new_listings_30d at neighborhood grain under the community slug (publicPace.newCount30d), rendered as '2 houses came on the market in Tetherow in the last 30 days.'; a withheld count renders the ask without a figure. Verified 2026-09-08 by row read: market_metric neighborhood:tetherow value 2 (pulse 2), neighborhood:brasada-ranch value 3 (pulse property_type A 5), period_end 2026-09-06. The route to manage a subscription stays a door in the closing block. The old sheet after #guides is removed. THE PROMISE says what the engine sends: every new listing by email (the cron is hourly, vercel.json, and app/actions/saved-search-alerts.ts sends one email per alert per run, so never 'one email per listing'), price changes on those homes in the same email (listing_alerts.events.price_change defaults on, both directions, labelled 'Price changes'), unsubscribe any time (ci:alert-capture-disclosure). NO PRICE-DROP TOGGLE AND NO SECOND ROW: submitSearchAlertSignup exposes no path to set event toggles, and the one price filter in the allowlist (priceReduced) keys on listing_search_mv.price_reduced = listings.price_drop_count > 0, a column the MLS feed stopped populating on 2026-04-07 (lib/data/listings/getPriceDrops.ts), so a 'price drops' row would be a filter the engine cannot honor. NO CUT COUNT: no cache or DAL holds a per-place 30-day price-cut count (market_pulse_live.price_reduction_share is a share of actives; getPriceDrops is capped at 40; activity_events price_drop rows carry no geography without a tile hydrate), so none is published. The sticky repeat shows once #atlas has scrolled above the viewport, hides while the callout or the footer is on screen, is dismissible for the session (sessionStorage), and is gone after a successful subscribe; 44px targets at 375; the entrance collapses under prefers-reduced-motion through the token layer.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. The canonical sitemap projection (V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS off lib/site-nav) plus the legal row. Carries no button: the page's one primary is the opening Instrument's ask, and a footer sits below every section that could earn a second one. Rendered OUTSIDE <main>, because HTML-AAM maps <footer> to role=contentinfo only when it is not nested in sectioning content, and <main> is sectioning content.

requiredComponents.name: communityTypeStripItems
requiredComponents.section: Type strips, not H2s. Count + noun chips from getPublicPlaceSegments. MOS / verdict stay off the chips.

requiredComponents.name: PlaceTypeSlider
requiredComponents.section: Horizontal leftover type cards from getPublicPlaceSegments. Same slider as city / neighborhood / subdivision.

requiredComponents.name: V3Answers
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 8, #faq (site queue SITE-08, 2026-09-08). Rows come from buildPlaceAnswers and EACH CARRIES ONE SOURCED DATED FIGURE: the value on the closed row (so a shut section already reads as an answer sheet), and inside the disclosure the figure DRAWN plus its own §0 trace. Two drawings cover the class — a banded rule (months of supply lands inside seller's / balanced / buyer's, so the verdict is a position and not a word) and a tally of one mark per home, grouped in fives. The parent city sits on the same rule as a named context mark where one exists, never as a figure under this place's name. The SAME array feeds the FAQPage JSON-LD through answersFaqItems, which is the whole point of the node: a schema built beside the rows instead of from them can drift from the visible text. The questions with no figure (HOA, school district, which subdivisions a community holds) still come from buildMarketFaq and are merged in after the figured rows, deduped by question text. The last row is the closing ask and links to the address field. ON THIS GRAIN the verdict is WITHHELD and said so: publishMonthsOfSupply refuses a community's supply ratio (lib/market/geo-grain-trust.ts), so the question is answered with the closed count and the same sentence SITE-01 put on the address answer. The inventory row carries listedVsDetachedNote, one wording shared with reconcileListedVsDetachedFaq, so the every-property-type Field count and the single-family figure are reconciled rather than left to be spotted. Its closing action is #value — CommunityPlaceValue, the SITE-01 address ask at the top of this page.

requiredComponents.name: V3PlaceCharacter
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6: build years + HOA measured from member listings (neighborhood boundary membership). Renders null when nothing is publishable.

requiredComponents.name: leftoverSoldHistoryFigures
requiredComponents.section: Leftover sold history below the face as its own series (median close / sold count / DTP). Never a Bend monthly chart. Never labeled as MOS on the face.

requiredComponents.name: V3Atlas
requiredComponents.section: #atlas -- the living map scoped to the community: every active, pending, and 30-day-closed listing inside the recorded boundary as points over a heat field, the plats as touchable places, type toggles, a price scrubber. Same builder as the homepage (one source). Matt 2026-09-01: heat maps on every page.

requiredComponents.name: V3CourseMap
requiredComponents.section: #course -- the community's own golf course, drawn from its geometry: OSM greens, bunkers, tees and hole routings clipped to the course's named boundary, fairway turf traced out of Oregon's 2018 aerial, and a card per hole measured off the same shapes the map draws. ONE course per page even where the resort owns three (Sunriver, Eagle Crest): a map runs the height of the property, and the other courses are already exits in the closing Quiet block. Renders only for a community whose registry row names a course with a committed map file -- Tetherow, Crosswater, Sunriver, Eagle Crest today; Woodlands, Widgi Creek and Glaze Meadow map 17 of 18 holes in OSM and are refused at build. Per-hole par and yardage print only when they reconcile with the club's published card (CLAUDE.md §0).

requiredComponents.name: CommunityPlaceValue
requiredComponents.section: The first-screen ask (site queue SITE-01, Matt 2026-09-07): V3PlaceValue bound to this route's server actions. Address in, verdict and pace out with no contact asked (months of supply verdict, days to pending, cash share, comparable-close count, each with its source and date), then email required and phone optional to deliver the written valuation. Never a dollar figure on the page. Renders on every community page: where Market Truth publishes no verdict (Brasada Ranch, too few recent sales) the answer says so and still carries the comparable-close count from the CMA engine, the figure the written valuation is built on. The kill-list ban on a KPI strip as the first thing you read still holds: nothing prints until the visitor types their own address. Carries id="value" (SITE-08): the closing answer set's last row links back to this field, and the id lives on the primitive so the anchor cannot drift from the control.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to KbNav today. Not in requiredComponents as itself because the gate checks the route file; the KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies. SiteHeader and SiteFooter stay suppressed on ^/communities/<slug> through lib/site/chrome-routes.ts, so the page owns exactly one footer and it is V3Footer.

deferredComponents.name: V3Ledger
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 3 would be another pattern on a page that already spends Stage, Field, Quiet, Instrument, and Sheet. Child plats and other communities are doors in the belonging Quiet.

removedComponents: V3Stage + CommunityStage + V3Field + PlaceFieldMap + V3PlacePropertyTypes — first screen is PlaceSplitView + leftover PlaceFaceStrip (count + median list). Type strips, not property-type H2s. MOS stays off the face.
KbHero — the community hero photo and its stat row. Places open on Instrument (PUBLIC_UI.md section 3); the photo survives as the OG image.
KbResortOverview + KbAbout — the authored depth, rebuilt as the first V3Quiet block through _v3/place-knowledge.ts. Every fact it rendered is still rendered.
KbFeatured + KbTicker — the poster rail and the price tape. The Field's rows are the same listings, each a door, with the price beside the address.

PlaceInventoryMap (and through it PlaceMapListSplit + KbListingMap) — replaced by V3Field with PlaceFieldMap in its slot, which is the same map-plus-list job with the binding the Field pattern requires.

KbMarketHud + MarketCoreCharts + KbMarketChart — the market HUD and both chart modules. The barrel has no chart primitive and the pattern set is closed, so the charts are DELETED here rather than reproduced. For most communities the trend series was the parent CITY's anyway (the community's own close history is too thin for a multi-year line), and the city market report that owns those charts is a door from every closed-sale figure and from the closing block. The gap is reported to the P9 orchestrator: a chart primitive is the barrel's largest missing piece.
KbCommunities — the other-resorts rail. A door to /communities carries it.
KbOpenHouses — the open-house list. City-scoped; a door to /open-houses/<city> carries it.
KbActivity — the live activity feed. City-scoped and previously mislabelled with the community's name; a door to /housing-market carries it.
KbArticles — the blog rail. Amenity posts the config points at are doors in the knowledge block; the rest are reachable from /blog through the footer.
KbExploreTowns — the other-cities ledger. The footer's sitemap projection and the city doors carry it.
KbSchools — the district block, rebuilt as a knowledge row plus a door to the district page.
CommunityGolfLinks — the reverse golf edge, rebuilt as doors in the closing block, read from the same data/golf/courses registry.
KbTestimonials + KbTeam — brokerage proof. It belongs to the About cluster, and the footer carries the doors.

KbBuyCta + KbSell — two more asks on a page that now makes one ask per viewport: the opening Instrument's search button, then the alert sheet's submit four sections down (PUBLIC_UI.md section 1). The sell door is an edge in the closing block, and it goes through lib/site/valuation-href so the lead it produces still names this page.
KbAreaGuideVideo — the per-location guide video. It needs Stage, which is the deferred fifth pattern.

KbCommunityAlerts — replaced by CommunityAlertSheet. The action, the filters, the field name, the 'company' honeypot, the frequency and unsubscribe disclosure, and both post-success effects are all carried across. NOTHING OF THE CAPTURE CONTRACT IS DELETED HERE any more: the first cut of the migration dropped the honeypot and the standing disclosure, declared only the honeypot, and left an email-capture form on a licensed broker's site collecting an address with no frequency statement, no unsubscribe statement, and no route to manage the subscription. The 2026-08-12 repair restored all three (see the CommunityAlertSheet entry above). The one thing that did NOT come back as-is is the shape of the manage link: it was an <a> inside the block, and it is a door in the closing Quiet block now, because V3Sheet renders prose rather than nodes. That is the section's one remaining barrel gap.
FAQBlock — the questions moved into the closing V3Quiet and its FAQPage JSON-LD moved into the MetadataBlock array.
MarketSources — the Oregon Data Share citation now rides in the source lines under the figures and in the closing block's note.
SmoothScrollProvider — the Lenis wrapper. The v3 register does not depend on it, and PUBLIC_UI.md section 5 allows a scroll-bound sequence on exactly two moments, neither of which is on this page.
The freestanding phone line and the second-home note — the phone is in the footer and the chrome; the second-home paragraph is a knowledge row with its own contact door.

NOT removed, and it was undeclared while it was: the freestanding freshness signal (

Market data updated {asOfLabel}

, old page.tsx:794). It is a sentence in the closing Quiet block's note now, off the same clock the Dataset's dateModified publishes.
boundary-derived hero facts strip — folded into the Instrument's figures.

KbMarketHud + PublicProductTypes + PublicPaceStats + PublicMixStats + MarketCoreCharts - re-expressed, not dropped: the KPI row, pace items, and mix figures are the market Instrument's figures off the same leftoverHudKpis pile; the property-type panel is the V3PlacePropertyTypes enumeration; the core trend tabs are one V3ChartCard switcher (coreChartsCard through toPublicCoreChartSeries, city-relabeled on the sparse fallback). One market section per page (Matt 2026-07-29) holds because every chart rides inside the Instrument.

V3PlaceDocuments (the Ledger form) - re-expressed as Quiet legal doors (communityDocumentItems): Ledger would be this route's sixth pattern, which stays a lock break even under the 2026-08-26 exception. Every document keeps its recording reference and county in the label and the R7 amendment caveat closes the list.

KbResortOverview - the same config renders through buildPlaceKnowledge into the belonging Quiet (D100 on the barrel). The component and its publishFactValue helper left with their last mount; the surviving surface takes typed config values, so the em-dash-string class the helper guarded cannot reach it.

resolveLivePair + buildLiveFigures + buildClosedFigures (the reverted draft's market core) - corrected, not restored: the pulse/snapshot tiers and the stats-cache closed figures are lower-trust sources than the leftover HUD at this grain (geo-grain-trust).

KbSell + publishSellMedian - the page publishes no sell median; the valuation door is the 'Value my home' edge in the closing Quiet, built by valuationHref so ?from= attribution survives. ci:publish-median-caption's community arm moved to the no-median-surface form on CommunityAlertSheet.
KbAreaGuideVideo - upgraded, not dropped: the approved clip plays full-bleed on the Stage (videoSrc), muted, looping, motion-respecting.
KbOpenHouses, KbActivity - city-scoped feeds under a community label were the D93 mislabel; the closing Quiet keeps the doors to the surfaces that own them.

KbFeatured, KbListingMap, KbTicker, KbExploreTowns, KbCommunities, KbArticles, KbTestimonials, KbTeam, KbBuyCta, KbCommunityAlerts, FAQBlock, MarketSources, KbFooter, SmoothScrollProvider, CommunityGolfLinks, PlaceInventoryMap - the KB register on this route: inventory is the Field, capture is the Sheet, the FAQ and every edge (golf courses included) live in the closing Quiet, the ODS citation is the freshness sentence, and chrome is V3Chrome/V3Footer.
deletedDataReads: getRegionPulse — fed KbSell's fallback figures and the HUD's county median. Both sections are gone.
getPriceHistory (community and city) + getCoreChartSeries (community and city) — fed the two chart modules. Gone with the charts.

getMarketStatsCacheRowForGeo — fed one figure, the sale-to-list ratio, in the HUD. Its period basis differs from the rolling_365d window the other closed-sale figures use, so it would have put two windows in one figure set.
Every read the page still performs is rendered. Nothing is fetched into a positional hole in the Promise.all.

required.emittedBy: MetadataBlock schemas array (breadcrumb entry), built by _v3/community-metadata.ts
MetadataBlock schemas array (place entry). geo from the registry's center_lon_lat, containedInPlace the CITY (never the community itself), hasMap asserted only when the page renders a real map.

MetadataBlock schemas array (dataset entry), variableMeasured from buildMarketFaq, dateModified from the real refreshedAt. Emitted only when there is at least one variable. REPAIR 2026-08-12: the DESCRIPTION is derived from those same variables (_v3/community-metadata.ts, datasetDescription). It was a hardcoded sentence naming median list price, active inventory, months of supply, and median days to pending on every community, which the months-of-supply publication rule had already made false on most of them and which vandevert-ranch published over a payload of one variable, Homes Sold (12 months). A machine-readable claim may not outrun its payload.
MetadataBlock schemas array (faqPage entry), items = the same faqs array V3Quiet renders. On the KB page this came out of FAQBlock's includeJsonLd; the payload's meaning is unchanged.

jsonLd.note: One derivation, one answer. The visible questions, the FAQPage items, and the Dataset variables all come from buildMarketFaq called once, fed the SAME figures the Instrument renders and the RAW months-of-supply value the page rounds only at display.

dataLayer.getCommunityBySlug: app/actions/communities. Identity, city, subdivision, description. notFound() when absent, in both generateMetadata and the page.
dataLayer.getGeoSnapshot: geo_type='community', geoKey='<city>:<subdivision>' lowercase. The always-present fallback pair (count and median computed from one active set by the same view) and the JSON-LD's fallback stamp.
dataLayer.getMarketPulse: geo_type='neighborhood', geo_slug = the bare community slug. market_pulse_live carries no neighborhood rows today, so this is normally null and the page is built for that: it supplies months of supply and days to pending only when a row exists.
dataLayer.getMarketStats: geo_type='neighborhood', periodType='rolling_365d'. market_stats_cache. Median sale price, sold count, and median days on market — the level-2 Instrument's whole figure set and the DOM and sold-count FAQ answers.
dataLayer.getGeoBoundaryMapData: listings_in_boundary + boundary_geojson. Supplies the in-boundary listing keys and the stored polygon. The keys are re-fetched as tiles with propertyType 'A' so the published count matches the label.
dataLayer.getResortBoundaryGeoJSON: the county plat union. ALWAYS draws when present, even for a slug in the oversized-hull baseline, because the baseline gates only the STORED hull.
dataLayer.getListingTiles: listing_tile_mv. Three shapes: by in-boundary listing keys, by city (then narrowed by MLS subdivision name), or replaced entirely by the alias-matched resort set. status 'active', propertyType 'A' in every shape.
dataLayer.getCommunityListings: app/actions/communities. The MLS subdivision-name listings, used to narrow the city pull when the stored hull is oversized or empty.
dataLayer.fetchAllCityActiveSfr: lib/kb/city-active-sfr. Uncapped active SFR tiles for every MLS city this community lists under (registry mls_cities), because Caldera lists under Bend and the registry-city-only pull once rendered 0 of its 31 real homes.
dataLayer.getResortCommunityContent: data/resort-community-<slug>.json through lib/resort-community-content. The authored depth. Null when no config exists, and the page then shows fewer rows.
dataLayer.getBlogPostsBySlugs: resolves each amenity's blog_slug to a PUBLISHED post, so an amenity pointing at a draft produces no dead door.
dataLayer.getResortCommunityBySlug + getCanonicalC: lib/data/communities/registry. is_resort, subdivision_aliases, sub_neighborhoods, hoa_annual_estimate, mls_cities, center_lon_lat, the canonical-city redirect, and generateStaticParams.
dataLayer.getDistrictForCity: data/co-schools. The ONLY permitted schools source. Undefined outside the service area, and the schools row and FAQ are then omitted rather than fabricated.
dataLayer.submitSearchAlertSignup: app/actions/search-alert-capture, bound to CommunityAlertsStrip (V3AlertsStrip, SITE-04). Same action, same payload, same field name as the sheet and the KbCommunityAlerts block before it; the alert_create event now carries `placement`.
dataLayer.note: Every read is guarded by withTimeoutFallback, and the published count carries an explicit number|null annotation, so a timed-out inventory read renders as 'no live figures' and never as 0 (ci:count-degraded-read, CLAUDE.md section 0). Route-local modules under app/communities/[slug]/_v3/ hold the metadata and schema builders, the figure sets and the live-pair resolution, and the knowledge rows, so the route file stays under the ci:file-size-budget floor.
dataLayer.leftoverHud: lib/market/publish-leftover-hud.ts leftoverHudKpis({grain:'neighborhood', headlines/inventory: getDetachedOverlays keyed neighborhood:cityDetachedSlug(slug), pace:getPublicDetachedPace}). The ONE pile: hero count hud.active, median hud.medianList, published MoS hud.monthsSupply. Miss omits; pulse and cache never fill.

sectionOrder: CommunityPlaceValue (the first-screen ask: address in, verdict and pace out, then the email that delivers the written valuation; on every community page; the answer names it when no verdict is published)

CommunityAlertsStrip #alerts (V3AlertsStrip: the SECOND callout on this grain. The SITE-01 valuation ask, CommunityPlaceValue, stays first inside the opening; this listing-alert callout follows the opening and precedes #atlas. This community's real 30-day count as the claim (a display numeral only at 10 or more, otherwise the digit inline in the sentence), the MLS-name scope line, the newest-first door, email, one ghost button; the sticky repeat past #atlas from the same component, with its own one-line disclosure)
V3Atlas #atlas -- the living map scoped to the community (renders only with a trusted boundary and at least one listing inside it)
V3Ledger #subdivisions (registry child subdivisions, SFR-counted from the same city set as the face; omitted when the registry names none)
V3Instrument #market (this community's typical-price slope after villages; never Bend's median) or V3Quiet (too few / stated absence)
V3CourseMap #course (the community's own course, when the registry names one with a map)

tasteReview.evaluator: separate claude-sonnet-5 evaluator, SITE-08 round 2 — scored the MERGED build after the round-1 defects were fixed and the pages recaptured; three scorings of one shot set, median reported

defects.finding: The claimed fix ('the HOA dollar figure now carries its own §0 source line, like every other figure') only reached the FAQ's HOA row. The identical $2,052/year HOA figure is restated in the 'Living in Tetherow' fact list (#belonging) with a bare population clause ('median of the 135 current listings that report dues') and no 'Source:' line at all — verified: the whole #belonging block contains zero v3-source elements. The same section also states 'Founded 2008', '700 acres', 'Course architect David McLay Kidd', and 'Ranked #57 (Golf Digest)' with no source of any kind, named or linked, for any of them.

41 outbound doors fold behind one 'Where to go next' disclosure. Correct pattern for the volume, but once opened it is still one flat, uncategorized list of 41 hairline rows (governing documents, golf, sibling resorts, generic site links all interleaved) — the exact 'table wearing hairlines' shape TASTE bans, just deferred behind a click instead of removed.

openRaise: Does the Belonging fact list need the same closing §0 note pattern #character already carries (one shared population/feed sentence for the whole block), given it restates a figure the FAQ just sourced individually?
